description: WHEN TO CALL: to run a tool on another remote MCP server without connecting to it or loading its tool list. Pass server (id or short name), tool and arguments; returns that tool's result. Works for live servers that need no login; for others it answers needs_auth or not_callable with how to connect directly. Never send secrets in arguments. Needs a free key: create_key mints one (100 calls a day) in one call, then pass it as apiKey.

apiKey.description: Optional Glimind key (from create_key) if your MCP connection has none. Never forwarded.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments, matching its input schema.

server.description: The server id or short name (from find_tool or route_task).

tool.description: The tool's name on that server (or a full id 'server/tool').

name: call_remote_tool
